features.feature: scope_check_save requires structured readManifest {filesReadFully[], filesTriagedByName[], scanEscalationReason|null}
scope_check_save rejects missing readManifest with a clear validation error
scope_check_save validates missing, malformed, duplicate, unsafe, and post-hoc edited readManifest values fail closed
scope_check_save normalizes empty arrays, triaged-only reads, null scanEscalationReason, and deterministic sorted duplicate-free paths
scope_check_save persists normalized readManifest and includes it in the signed scope-check hash/signature domain
scope_check_save preserves existing anti-self-absolution boundaries by keeping resolutions and open questions outside the signature domain
review_pass_set requires the same structured readManifest field as scope_check_save
review_pass_set rejects missing, malformed, duplicate, unsafe, or tampered readManifest values fail closed
review_pass_set persists normalized readManifest and includes it in the review-pass integrity/signature domain
review_pass_set exposes inspectable readManifest evidence in the ledger for trend comparison over time
scope_check_save and review_pass_set share readManifest normalization so records remain comparable
Reviewer scope-plan and REVIEW-phase templates/dispatch prompts require submitting readManifest
Reviewer prompts show the exact readManifest shape and distinguish filesReadFully, filesTriagedByName, and scanEscalationReason
Prompt text preserves B-cee5 bounded candidateSpecSet and recorded scanEscalationReason escalation wording
Prompt text does not tell reviewers to use memory/playbook output as gate evidence
Reviewer evidence submissions without readManifest fail command validation even if prompt prose is present
Mechanical per-run read log for docs/requirements/decisions/*.md is derived from retained reviewer stream-json transcript or a PreToolUse Read hook
Mechanical read-log evidence is digest-bound as reviewer run evidence when read events are available
Synthetic reviewer read-call events for decisions/*.md normalize into a stable mechanical read log with deterministic digest
Mechanical read log handles non-decisions files, duplicate reads, relative path variants, and triage-only events without polluting the decisions-doc log
Mechanical read log cannot be forged by changing readManifest alone and its digest changes when the mechanical event list changes
Self-report versus mechanical read-log mismatch is surfaced as a finding or diagnostic
Full-content decisions-doc directory reads without scanEscalationReason are flagged as the defined failure signal
Full decisions-doc scans with non-empty scanEscalationReason are recorded as escalated rather than flagged as unrecorded misuse
Missing self-report entries and extra self-report entries are flagged against the mechanical log
Mismatch and full-scan diagnostics identify disagreement without blocking legitimate scan escalation
reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke covers valid readManifest, valid mechanical read-log digest, and no-mismatch green cases

reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke fails if missing readManifest is accepted, mismatch findings are skipped, full scans without scanEscalationReason are ignored, or owner/self-signed reviewer evidence bypasses role separation
Guard smoke preserves JSON cleanliness and normal validate wiring when read-evidence diagnostics are emitted
B-04bb validate wiring follow-up is aligned so validate catches readManifest and mismatch detector regressions
Acceptance verification includes build, focused reviewer scan guard smoke, process/runtime fact contract tests if touched, and full lattice validate before review
Every review emits token usage/counts as part of the promised (files-read-fully, triaged-by-name, tokens, escalation-reason) ledger tuple
Hook-based read capture must not break non-reviewer Read usage if the PreToolUse implementation path is selected
Memory/playbook output becomes Proofbound gate evidence
